descricao: Very little is known about the actual structure of Level 6, as the level is shrouded in total and complete darkness. No light permeates the level, and light sources brought into the level have no function. Navigation of Level 6 is carried out by feeling one's way through the darkness, which has revealed that the level is comprised of a seemingly endless series of tight hallways made of a smooth, cold material (likely concrete.) In addition to being permanently dark, Level 6 is also eerily silent, akin to a soundproof room.
